title: Good quality practical towels. Exactly what I wanted.
text: Good quality practical towels. Exactly what I wanted.. These are perfect, they are not super pretty but they are superrrr soft and very practical which makes them perfect for me, and they have the exact amount of softness I like in my towels, which is honestly very hard to find, I will buy more just because they are that great, they look very normal but I appreciate the material and good quality a lot.
